framing.recovered_from: The goal is one physically controlled monkey in a small forest: walk on all fours, steer, stop, approach a rigid trunk, attach, climb, hold, descend, release and walk again, with a usable camera and complete player flow.

repeatable_objective.definition: ONE complete ground -> trunk -> climb -> hold -> descend -> release -> ground loop, in one session, repeated as free play
repeatable_objective.finite_frame_core_clause_verbatim: One monkey, ground movement, one climbable trunk, return to ground, explicit success/failure behavior; broader features excluded
repeatable_objective.success_loop_clause_current_verbatim: Player approaches, attaches, ascends, holds, descends, releases and resumes all-fours walking in one session
repeatable_objective.failure_semantics: explicit success/failure behavior per the frozen core clause; failures stay physical under the pinned law: No kinematic locomotion substitute or invisible support force is permitted.
repeatable_objective.repetition: free-play repetition, no scripted progression; the loop is the whole game frame, so each session is one more attempt at the same finite objective
repeatable_objective.milestone_order_material_first_verbatim: Reusable matter is the architecture; walking through woods is the first product milestone, followed by the existing climb/return goal. Additional materials remain extensible, not universal-physics prerequisites.
